definitions.explanation: Speaking ill of someone or damaging their reputation through false or malicious statements.

examples.japanese: {誹謗|ひぼう}⟦{中傷|ちゅうしょう}→中傷：11314_chuushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: Slander and defamation are not acceptable.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誹謗|ひぼう}⟦{中傷|ちゅうしょう}→中傷：11314_chuushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}→社会問題：25686_shakaimondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Online slander has become a social problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名人|ゆうめいじん}→有名人：17812_yuumeijin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誹謗|ひぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}み→書き込み：09225_kakikomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{法的|ほうてき}{措置|そち}→法的措置：24477_houtekisochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}られた→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: Because posts slandering celebrities increased, legal action was taken.

notes:
{誹謗|ひぼう} refers to slandering or speaking ill of someone. It is almost always used in the compound {誹謗|ひぼう}⟦{中傷|ちゅうしょう}→中傷：11314_chuushou⟧, which is the standard legal and media term for defamation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誹謗|ひぼう}⟦{中傷|ちゅうしょう}→中傷：11314_chuushou⟧ (slander and defamation)
- {誹謗|ひぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to slander)
- {誹謗|ひぼう}⟦{中傷|ちゅうしょう}→中傷：11314_chuushou⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (anti-defamation measures)

The word has become especially prominent in discussions about cyberbullying and online harassment. Japanese law treats {誹謗|ひぼう}⟦{中傷|ちゅうしょう}→中傷：11314_chuushou⟧ as a punishable offense, and recent legal reforms have made it easier to identify anonymous online slanderers.
